title: Classic American Sausage Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole filled with sausages, creamy sauce and wholesome goodness.
instructions: Cook the sausages in a large skillet over medium-high heat, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the casserole onions to the skillet and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet contents to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange the sliced potatoes on top of the sausages.
Pour the baked beans and creamy cheese sauce over the potatoes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and the top is golden brown.
